verdict.rationale: Stripe's Disputes API explicitly supports uploading structured evidence, responding to disputes, and receiving dispute lifecycle events via webhooks, directly matching the story. However, evidence lacks detail on structured evidence field templates, Dashboard-based dispute workflows, or independent/hands-on confirmation of the full lifecycle tracking experience. missing for 10: Dashboard UI walkthrough for evidence submission, structured evidence field schema/templates, independent/hands-on validation of dispute resolution tracking.
